title: Gears of War: E-Day’s New Story Trailer Brings Marcus and Dom Back to Emergence Day
description: A new gamescom ONL trailer put the relationship between Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago back at the center of Gears of War: E-Day ahead of its October 6, 2026 launch.
body:
Gears of War: E-Day returned during gamescom Opening Night Live with a new story-focused trailer that reinforces The Coalition’s prequel setup: Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago at the beginning of the Locust War.

The release date itself is not new — Xbox already has E-Day scheduled for October 6, 2026 — but the ONL trailer is a meaningful campaign beat because it pushes character and early-war context to the foreground as the game approaches launch.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: Gears of War: E-Day key art featuring the series skull-and-cog emblem glowing red beneath the E-Day logo.

contentBlocks.text: The new presentation leans into Marcus and Dom rather than treating Emergence Day only as spectacle. That matches The Coalition’s established pitch for the prequel: revisiting the beginning of the Locust War while rebuilding the brotherhood that defines the original trilogy.
contentBlocks.heading: The ONL trailer is about the people at the center of E-Day

contentBlocks.text: Xbox describes the game as a prequel set 14 years before the first Gears of War. Players follow Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago as the Locust threat erupts, giving the studio room to show familiar characters before they become the veterans players already know.
contentBlocks.heading: E-Day takes place before the original Gears of War

contentBlocks.text: Gears of War: E-Day launches October 6, 2026 on Xbox Series X|S and PC. Xbox has also confirmed that gamescom attendees are getting the first public hands-on opportunity with the campaign.
contentBlocks.heading: October 6 remains the launch date
